round2_n27.note: Round 2 uses a different, non-overlapping n=27 sample per task (seed 20260909) and, for agent_safety, a different Annotator B than round 1 (round 1's B was an unrelated-ML-subfield colleague; round 2's B is a CUHK MMLab LLM postdoc). NOT pooled with round 1 into a single n=54 statistic: round 1's raw per-item human labels were not preserved (only the aggregate kappa was recorded at the time), so a statistically correct pooled kappa -- which requires each round's label marginals, not just its kappa -- cannot be computed from what remains. Reporting both rounds separately is the honest option; it is also itself informative, see below.
